incident: The original worker fetched three pending page reads while the model runner still held its write lock. Ingestion failed before any response was delivered to a model.
recovery: Reuse the saved response, reacquire only the two unpersisted responses, and use recovery_web_worker.js to persist all results before ingestion. No model call or candidate answer was retried.
scope: Development infrastructure incident; all candidate decisions and original model-call costs preserved. Include unknown overhead when discussing end-to-end cost or latency.
